title: CodeBlock 代码块
description: 只读的预格式化文本块（日志、请求体、配置），位于有名称且可键盘聚焦的滚动区域中。

events.name: minerva-copy
events.description: The copy button (or `copy()`) was used: `detail: { text, success }` (`text` is the copied text; React's `onCopied` is called with it on success).

events.name: minerva-mark-click
events.description: A mark was clicked (not at the end of a text selection drag): `detail: { mark, originalEvent }` (`mark` is the item of `marks`, the topmost where they overlap; React's `onMarkClick`).

wc:minerva-code-block.summary: Read-only, scrollable code region with syntax highlighting and an optional copy button.
wc:minerva-code-block.description: A read-only block of preformatted text: logs, payloads, configuration (`<CodeBlock>` of React). It is a named, keyboard-focusable region so its overflow can be scrolled without a mouse. The text is the `code` property, else the element's text content (rendered verbatim, never parsed as HTML; escape `<` in markup or set `code`). `language` highlights the syntax (colored spans, see `--code-token-<type>-color`; `no-highlight` keeps plain text) and sets `class="language-<x>"` / `data-language` on the `<code>` (`language="auto"` detects it from the text); `show-language` shows it as a small label, `show-line-numbers` numbers the lines. With `copyable`, a copy button writes the text to the clipboard; its label switches to "Copied" / "Copy failed" for two seconds and the result is announced through a polite live region. `marks` wraps character ranges in `<mark>`s over the highlighting; `getSelectionRange()` maps the user's selection to offsets to create them.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Source text (default: the element's text content)

properties.name: language
properties.description: Language of the code: highlights its syntax (javascript / js, typescript / ts, jsx, tsx, json, css / scss, html / xml / vue, bash / sh, python / py, yaml, sql, diff, markdown / md; other names render plain text) and sets `class="language-<x>"` / `data-language` on the `<code>`. `auto` detects the language from the text (`detectCodeLanguage`, "plain" when unsure): the `<code>` and the label then show the detected name

properties.name: noHighlight
properties.description: Keeps the code plain (no syntax highlighting) despite `language` (the React library's `highlight={false}`)

properties.name: showLineNumbers
properties.description: Numbers the lines in a gutter (aria-hidden, not part of the copied text)

properties.name: showLanguage
properties.description: Shows the `language` as a small label in the top-right corner (e.g. "JSON")

properties.name: noWrap
properties.description: Scrolls long lines horizontally instead of wrapping them (the React library's `wrap={false}`)

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: Maximum height before the block scrolls (CSS value, numbers are pixels)

properties.name: copyable
properties.description: Shows a copy button writing the text to the clipboard

properties.name: marks
properties.description: Character ranges to mark (saved highlights, annotations, search hits), rendered as `<mark part="code-mark">` over the syntax highlighting (the copied text stays the raw code). `start` / `end` are UTF-16 offsets into `text`, clamped to it; empty ranges are ignored. Marks may cross tokens and lines (with show-line-numbers a mark is cut at each line break). Where marks overlap, the later one in the array wins (its color, class, title and click). `color`: a theme color name (a translucent tint) or any CSS color (default: translucent yellow, `--code-block-mark-bg`). Set the property, or a JSON array in the `marks` attribute

properties.name: clickableMarks
properties.description: Gives the marks a click affordance (pointer cursor, hover underline): set it when listening to `minerva-mark-click`

methods.name: getSelectionRange
methods.description: Offsets in `text` of the user's selection inside the code (to save it as a mark), `null` when nothing of the code is selected. Reads the selection through the shadow root (`getComposedRanges`, or the shadow root's own selection in Chromium); `selection` overrides it

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies the text to the clipboard; resolves with whether it worked

events.name: minerva-copy
events.description: The copy button (or `copy()`) was used: `detail: { text, success }` (`text` is the copied text; React's `onCopied` is called with it on success).

events.name: minerva-mark-click
events.description: A mark was clicked (not at the end of a text selection drag): `detail: { mark, originalEvent }` (`mark` is the item of `marks`, the topmost where they overlap; React's `onMarkClick`).

parts.name: root
parts.description: The positioned outer wrapper of the region and its actions (only when copyable, or with a language label)

parts.name: region
parts.description: The `<pre>` scroll region (role=region): the visible box of the code

parts.name: line-number
parts.description: The number of a line, in the gutter (with show-line-numbers; aria-hidden, generated content)

parts.name: code-mark
parts.description: A `<mark>` wrapping a marked character range (with marks; also has `data-mark-id`, `data-mark-color` and the mark's className)

cssProperties.name: --code-block-max-height
cssProperties.description: Maximum height before the block scrolls (default: none)

cssProperties.name: --code-block-mark-bg
cssProperties.description: Default background of the marks (default: a translucent yellow)

cssProperties.name: --icon-button-pressed-color
cssProperties.description: Icon color of a pressed toggle

cssProperties.name: --icon-button-size
cssProperties.description: Width and height of the button (every size; defaults follow the density's control heights)

cssProperties.name: --icon-button-icon-size
cssProperties.description: Font size of the icon (every size)

cssProperties.name: --icon-button-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the square shape (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --code-block-max-height
vars.description: Maximum height before the block scrolls (default: none)

vars.name: --code-block-mark-bg
vars.description: Default background of the marks (default: a translucent yellow)

files.apps/docs/src/docs/pages/code-block/wc/l:
<!-- prettier-ignore -->
<minerva-code-block language="python" show-line-numbers show-language copyable aria-label="Fibonacci">def fibonacci(n: int) -> list[int]:
    """The first n Fibonacci numbers."""
    numbers = [0, 1]
    while len(numbers) < n:
        numbers.append(numbers[-1] + numbers[-2])
    return numbers[:n]

print(fibonacci(10))</minerva-code-block>

translationResources.title: CodeBlock 代码块
translationResources.description: 只读的预格式化文本块（日志、请求体、配置），位于有名称且可键盘聚焦的滚动区域中。

basic.title: 基础用法
basic.description: 文本按原样渲染，默认长行自动换行；language="json" 开启语法高亮。

languages.title: 多种语言
languages.description: language 选择语法：JavaScript / TypeScript（JSX、TSX）、JSON、CSS、HTML、Bash、Python、YAML、SQL、diff 与 Markdown（支持 ts、sh、py、yml、md 等常用别名）。showLanguage 显示小标签；其他语言按纯文本渲染。

auto-language.title: 自动识别语言
auto-language.description: 对语言未知的代码（例如没有 class 的 EPUB <pre>），language="auto" 通过快速启发式（只读取前 4 KB）从文本识别语言，再高亮并在标签中显示识别结果；无法确定时为 "plain"。标记（marks）照常可用。minerva-design/core 的 detectCodeLanguage 可单独执行同样的识别。

line-numbers.title: 行号
line-numbers.description: showLineNumbers 在左侧显示行号，行号对屏幕阅读器隐藏，选择或复制代码时不会包含行号。

no-wrap.title: 滚动日志
no-wrap.description: wrap={false} 保持行完整并水平滚动；maxHeight 限制高度。

copyable.title: 复制按钮
copyable.description: copyable 在右上角添加复制按钮；结果（“已复制” / “复制失败”）显示在按钮上并播报给屏幕阅读器。复制成功后，onCopied 会收到被复制的文本。

marks.title: 标记（已保存的高亮）
marks.description: marks 在语法高亮之上叠加字符范围（代码中的偏移量；重叠时数组中靠后的标记优先）。minerva-design/core 的 getCodeSelectionRange 将用户的选区转换为可保存的偏移量；onMarkClick 报告被点击的标记（此处为删除）。复制仍复制原始代码。

CodeBlockProps.aria-label: 代码区域的无障碍名称
CodeBlockProps.wrap: 长行自动换行而不是水平滚动
CodeBlockProps.maxHeight: 代码块开始滚动前的最大高度
CodeBlockProps.tabIndex: 区域的 Tab 顺序（默认可聚焦）
CodeBlockProps.copyable: 显示复制按钮，将文本写入剪贴板并播报结果
CodeBlockProps.onCopied: 复制按钮成功将文本写入剪贴板后调用，参数为被复制的文本（失败时不调用）；原生 onCopy 仍作用于元素
CodeBlockProps.language: 代码语言：开启语法高亮（javascript、typescript、jsx、tsx、json、css、html、bash、python、yaml、sql、diff、markdown 及其别名）；"auto" 根据代码自动识别（detectCodeLanguage，无法确定时为 "plain"），标签、class 与 data-language 显示识别结果；不设置时为纯文本
CodeBlockProps.highlight: 是否高亮 language 的语法（false：纯文本）
CodeBlockProps.showLineNumbers: 在左侧显示行号（对辅助技术隐藏，不会被复制）
CodeBlockProps.showLanguage: 在右上角以小标签显示语言
CodeBlockProps.marks: 要标记的字符范围（已保存的高亮、批注）：{ start, end, color?, className?, id?, title? }，偏移量为代码中的 UTF-16 偏移，在语法颜色之上渲染为 <mark>。范围会被限制在代码内，空范围被忽略；重叠时靠后的标记优先。color 为主题颜色名（半透明色调）或任意 CSS 颜色
CodeBlockProps.onMarkClick: 点击标记时调用（拖动选择结束时除外），参数为标记（重叠时为最上层的标记）和事件

cssVars.--code-block-max-height: 出现滚动前的最大高度（默认 none）
cssVars.--code-block-mark-bg: 标记的默认背景（半透明黄色）

line-numbers.title: 行号
line-numbers.description: show-line-numbers 在左侧显示行号（对屏幕阅读器隐藏）；复制时仍复制原始文本。

marks.title: 标记（已保存的高亮）
marks.description: marks 在语法颜色之上叠加字符范围；getSelectionRange() 将用户的选区转换为偏移量，minerva-mark-click 报告被点击的标记（此处为删除）。

props.code: 源文本（默认：元素的文本内容）。
props.language: 代码语言：开启语法高亮，并在 <code> 上设置 class="language-<x>" / data-language。"auto" 根据文本自动识别（detectCodeLanguage；无法确定时为 "plain"）。
props.noHighlight: 即使设置了 language 也保持纯文本（相当于 React 库的 highlight={false}）。
props.noWrap: 长行水平滚动而不是换行（相当于 React 版的 wrap={false}）。
props.showLineNumbers: 在左侧显示行号（aria-hidden，不属于复制的文本）。
props.showLanguage: 在右上角以小标签显示语言（如 "JSON"）。
props.marks: 要标记的字符范围（{ start, end, color?, className?, id?, title? }，文本中的 UTF-16 偏移）：可设置属性或 JSON 数组特性。重叠时靠后的标记优先。
props.clickableMarks: 让标记呈现可点击样式（指针光标、悬停下划线）；监听 minerva-mark-click 时设置。
props.text: 显示和复制的文本（只读）。

events.minerva-copy: 使用了复制按钮或 copy()（detail: { text, success }；text 为复制的文本，React 的 onCopied 在成功时收到它）。
events.minerva-mark-click: 点击了标记（拖动选择结束时除外；detail: { mark, originalEvent }；对应 React 的 onMarkClick）。

cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: 复制按钮悬停时的背景。
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: 复制按钮按下时的图标颜色。
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: 复制按钮按下时的背景。
cssVars.--icon-button-size: 复制按钮的宽度和高度。

methods.copy: 将文本复制到剪贴板；以是否成功作为结果。
methods.getSelectionRange: 用户在代码中的选区在 text 中的偏移量（{ start, end, text }），无选区时为 null；通过 shadow root 读取选区。
